text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki is in the lead!
The winner is Yaeno Muteki!
(Woooooaaaaahhh!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...

I headed to the underground tunnel to celebrate the victory.
There, standing motionless in the center,
was Yaeno Muteki.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer-dono...
choice_data_list: Congratulations on your Kikuka Sho victory!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...However... I...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Today's race...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"It is well and good that we achieved victory, but...
it was nowhere near a run I could be satisfied with...!"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaaaahhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(Wha...?! Her presence has exploded...!
An overwhelming aura covering heaven and earth...!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (Push back! Fire up your spirit! Burn it up!!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (Burn...! Urgh...!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(...I refuse to lose...! Win!!
I want to win... and yet...!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (Why won't the raging fire ignite...!?)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Could there be... could there truly be such a disgrace...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
If I were consumed by the raging fire within, that would be one thing!!
To fall without even igniting my fighting spirit...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: What an unsightly run!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I am unworthy to wear the Chrysanthemum Crown!
To have made such a pathetic display of myself... it's infuriating...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Why couldn't I make the raging fire burn within me...!

The long distance of the Kikuka Sho was always a tough ask for her.
The fact that she won it should be hailed as a magnificent feat, and yet...

More than feeling joy, she seemed to harbor
deep regrets about how she ran.

It was true that even when facing Super Creek,
Yaeno Muteki didn't show much competitive spirit.
The reason that comes to mind is—
choice_data_list: Is it because Chiyono O and Mejiro Ardan aren't here...?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

The absence of the rivals she harbored such intense competitiveness toward.
Up until now, Yaeno Muteki had been driven by a fierce desire to defeat the two of them.

That had fueled her obsession with victory.
However, I told Yaeno Muteki that I couldn't
feel any of that obsession from her today.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
An obsession born from the desire
to defeat Chiyono O-san and Ardan-san...

text_block_list.name: Ardan & Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Haaaaaaaaah!!
Yaaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I don't care if my legs shatter into pieces!!
I will burn up this very life
and carve proof that I existed right here and now!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no, nooo!!
*I'm* going to win the Derby! Meeeeee!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(............As if I'd lose!
Like hell I'll go down hereeee!!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ORRAAAAAAHHHHHHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: The only reason I could run like I did today is because I was pulled forward by the sheer passion of you both.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I didn't want to lose to that sheer tenacity...
I wanted to burn my soul and shine brightly,
just like the two of them.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed... My heart burned with the sole desire
to defeat Chiyono O-san and Ardan-san.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Their obsession with the Derby was staggering,
and I was swept along by that sheer tenacity..."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ..."Obsession."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
My desire for victory today
isn't quite strong enough to be called an "obsession"...

—Indeed.
What Yaeno Muteki lacked was "obsession."

Sakura Chiyono O harbored a fierce desire
to stand side-by-side with Maruzensky,
the idol she so deeply admired.

Mejiro Ardan made a desperate resolution:
to run even at the cost of her life, simply to etch proof of her existence.

Holding their own "obsessions" close to heart,
they turned them into a fierce drive for victory.

A feeling that surpasses "wanting to win."
The "obsession" of "refusing to yield" is what
ultimately decides the match in the very final moments.

"Obsession" is not something
that can be given by others.
She must find it for herself—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Without relying on Chiyono O-san and the others,
I must find that "obsession" within myself...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
choice_data_list: There's no need to rush. You'll get stronger, I promise.

text_block_list.text:
“Obsession” is a power that creates something extra.
I explain that she just needs to strengthen her physicality
enough to win even with little obsession.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Understood.
I will continue to dedicate myself to my training as always.
Whether Yaeno Muteki can foster a fierce tenacity—for now, there is nothing to do but leave it to her and watch over her.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Please wait a moment.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: *Inhale*... *Exhale*!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Here you go.
choice_data_list: What do you think about the "Osaka Hai"?

text_block_list.text:
Having watched the Kikuka-sho,
I told Yaeno Muteki that her strengths shone far better in medium distances than in long distances.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I see, so that's why you're aiming for the spring medium-distance GⅠ, the Osaka Hai.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
If it is a GⅠ, I am sure to encounter formidable opponents.
I have no objections.
And so, the next goal was decided: the Osaka Hai!
